title: Before-and-after reveal
one_liner: Open on the worst version with a question, show the real fix in quick one-second beats, then flash into the result and hold.
best_for: Visible transformations: product brands, stylists, organisers, designers, renovators, editors.

palette.use: question pill, BEFORE plate (at 80%), caption outline
label and caption text, the reveal flash
AFTER plate, the one sparkle, process step titles

pace: 11.5 s: 4 s before, 2.6 s process (four 0.6 s beats with tactile sounds), 5 s held after
signature_moves: A wipe starts revealing the after across your face and is cut off by a 4-frame white flash
Fast push (110% to 100%) into the warm-graded after, gold AFTER plate and one sparkle on the same beat
Process beats show the real fix (on the demo: the real command, the HDR-to-SDR switch, the real colour scopes of both files)
